import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { category } from "../../../backend/schema/category";

export const categoryCms = customizeTable<typeof category>("category", {
    icon: "Tag",
    group: "Reference",
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    fields: {
        name: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    }
});
